text: Well, what im getting at is it doesnt matter, u can do that, or u can do one at a time, both ways dont change anything about the areas in which you end up selecting to create a face, this one exposes it like a belt, but its going to be the same output.
resolution: Captured the corrected invariant: deletion scheduling is irrelevant. Whether the triangle belt is removed all at once or one cell at a time, each output quad is determined solely by pairing the next boundary edge on the upper rail with the corresponding boundary edge on the lower rail. The prior 4-vs-6 deletion-count reasoning was discarded. No repository files changed.
